name: outbox
description: Transactional outbox on the v4 substrate. The v3 `operations` module bundled outbox events + a job queue; v4 splits them — the job runtime moves entirely into BullMQ (`defineJob` / `JobsManager`) and this module owns the Postgres-backed outbox (event row commits in the same tx as the domain write).
postInstall: Add the schema to your composed schema: `createApp({ schema: { ...accountsSchema, outboxEvents } })`
Wire the routes: `defineOutboxRoutes(app, { service, drainer, provider })`
If you're migrating from v3 operations: the `Job` entity + JobController are NOT ported. Move job processing to `defineJob` from @sixthsummit/ship-api (BullMQ-backed).
